description: You will serve as a FINANCIAL MANAGEMENT ANALYST in the Financial Management Support Line of NAVFAC OSF.
educationRequirements: This job does not have an education qualification requirement.
qualifications:
Your resume must demonstrate at least one year of specialized experience at or equivalent to the GS-13 grade level or pay band in the Federal service or equivalent experience in the private or public sector. Specialized experience must demonstrate the following: 1) Serving at a subject-matter authority and advisor on the interpretation and application of federal financial policy by applying federal laws, regulations, concepts, policies, and precedents from oversight authorities; 2) Developing new or modified financial management policies, procedures, and internal control frameworks; 3) Resolving complex financial issues, reconciling conflicting regulatory guidance, and establishing consistent interpretations for use by subordinate organizations and/or multiple stakeholders; 4) Assessing enterprise-level financial risk, determining long-term fiscal implications of strategic decisions, and developing innovative risk mitigation strategies through mastery knowledge of federal budget formulation, execution, accounting, and reporting requirements; and 5) Performing comprehensive financial management studies involving interrelated budgetary, accounting, and programmatic systems for large and complex programs of national significance or Congressional interest.

Additional qualification information can be found from the following Office of Personnel Management web site: https://www.opm.gov/policy-data-oversight/classification-qualifications/general-schedule-qualification-standards/#url=List-by-Occupational-Series

Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., professional, philanthropic, religious, spiritual, community, student, social). Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment.
title: FINANCIAL MANAGEMENT ANALYST
